title: The Shattered Veil
setting_summary: In the sprawling metropolis of Aethoria, where towering skyscrapers touch the smog-laden sky and every citizen is monitored by the all-seeing EyeNet, a group of rebels fights against an oppressive regime that has stripped them of their rights and freedoms. The city's rigid hierarchy and scarcity of resources create a tense environment ripe for rebellion.
